answer: Use a processor card fingerprint as an identity credential: at enrollment, verify a signed authorization and permit one active epoch identity per fingerprint; reject claims without it. Proposed rule, not current protocol: /bin/bash.05 processor cost per identity. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.05 once; 1,000 fake identities cost 0 (1,000 × /bin/bash.05). The descriptor can echo onyx, bridge and crystal as a fresh nonce. Limitation: prepaid or stolen cards can bypass the gate, and card requirements exclude some honest users.
